sources.title: Sultan0336/distilgpt2-imdb-sentiment · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Decoder: DistilGPT2: IMDb sentiment Fine-tuned for Sultan0336's encoder/decoder comparison assignment. Base model: distilbert/distilgpt2. Two-class sequence classification: 0 NEGATIVE, 1 POSITIVE. DistilBERT is bidirectional; DistilGPT2 uses causal attention with a classification head. This checkpoint predicts sentiment; it is not a conversational generator.
